cohort: Fertile-aged (aged 15-49) women with a pelvic fracture during 1998-2018 in Finland, compared to a control group of women without a preceding pelvic fracture
finding: Women with a previous pelvic fracture had higher rates of cesarean sections, preterm deliveries, and neonates requiring intensive care unit treatment.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was the primary mode of delivery despite the higher rate of cesarean section among women with a previous fracture of the pelvis.
